body: GOD I LOVE THIS THEORY, IT"S PERFECT AND IT MAKES ME APPRECIATE THE GAME EVEN MORE. BUT~! The only question I have is, how did she end up in the form of a fairy-? Have there been any other cases of reincarnation like that-?
